resources.name: Destiny Bound
resources.mission: Destiny Bound is a nonprofit organization committed to empowering families, our primary focus is youths ages 0-24. Our goal is to dismantle generational poverty by pairing tangible goods and innovative services. We thrive to be "change-agents" in our communities. Destiny Bound is a mobile community nonprofit.

resources.name: DIVAS for Social Justice
resources.mission: DIVAS for Social Justice empowers and inspires youth living in underserved communities in NYC to use tech and visual arts to promote social justice and become change makers in their communities. We do this by instilling values of community pride and promoting community engagement. We provide youth with knowledge, skills, and community connections that enable them to engage with social justice issues in their communities.

resources.name: Elite Community Foundation
resources.mission: Elite Community Foundation's mission is to reduce poverty, illness, and illiteracy both locally and globally. Via volunteer service, ECF seeks to erase barriers to health, wellness, education, and safety. ECF provides access and resources to individuals, families, and communities. We provide many virtual programs and welcome volunteers of all ages and from any location.

resources.name: Krishti Inc
resources.mission: At KRISHTI INC., our mission is to enrich and uplift the community through the transformative power of theater. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming environment where artists and audiences from diverse backgrounds can come together to celebrate the art of storytelling. Our goal is to produce high-quality, innovative theatrical productions that inspire, educate, and entertain, fostering a deeper appreciation for the performing arts within our community. Through our dedication to artistic excellence and community engagement, we aim to nurture the next generation of talent and create lasting, meaningful connections between artists and audiences.

resources.name: Laurelton Lions Club
resources.mission: The Laurelton Lions Club's mission is to empower volunteers to serve their communities, meet humanitarian needs, encourage peace, and promote international understanding through Lions Clubs. This mission aligns with the overall mission of Lions Clubs International, which is dedicated to improving health and well-being, strengthening communities, and supporting those in need through humanitarian service and grants.
resources.fees: Not for humanistic or service projects.

resources.name: Persaud Community Affairs Pantry Inc
resources.mission: To provide nutritional food to veterans, essential workers, families, and the community at large. As President, veteran and a cancer survivor I wear a few hats for over 40 years of community activism. Jeany Persaud, UPF Ambassador, NY Federal Chaplain; NY President, Persaud Community Affairs Pantry Inc.; Queens Borough District Attorney Veterans Advisory Board; Director of Community Organizing, New American Voters Association (NAVA).

resources.name: Queens County Farm Museum
resources.address: 73-50 Little Neck Parkway, Glen Oaks, NY 11004
resources.mission: The Queens County Farm Museum's mission is to preserve, restore, and interpret its site, educating the public about the significance of its agricultural and horticultural past and present-day practices. The farm grows food, educates visitors, and preserves this 47-acre historic site as a living testament to New York City's agricultural roots.

resources.name: Service Now for Adult Persons Inc.
resources.address: 80-45 Winchester Blvd, Bldg.#4, Queens Village, NY 11427
resources.mission: SNAP is a social service agency dedicated to improving and enhancing the quality of life for older adults in Queens. SNAP strives to maintain older adults as viable community residents and to assist them in aging with dignity and independence, thereby preventing premature institutionalization. SNAP provides both direct services as well as linkages to all community resources. We serve individuals who are 60 years of age or older, homebound, and who reside in CDs 8, 11 and 13. These individuals are in need of assistance with daily tasks in order to stay safe in their home. Case management, meals on wheels and friendly visiting. The Caregiver Program provides support to someone caring for a loved one by providing services such as: respite, counseling/support groups, educational workshops and case assistance. We also have a Social Adult Day Program (SADS) for individuals with mild to moderate dementia. Both provide transportation for medical, shopping and recreational activities to and from the center.

resources.languages: English, Spanish, Korean, Mandarin, Creole. Translation services are available in multiple languages.

resources.name: Speakhire
resources.mission: Speakhire develops the social and cultural capital of individuals from immigrant households so they can become tomorrow's much needed workforce leaders. We deliver programs around career competency and leadership skills, while connecting individuals to caring individuals who can guide them as coaches and mentors. We seek schools and other community based organizations to partner with to fulfill our mission.
resources.fees: Yes, there are program service fees

resources.name: Springfield Gardens Church of the Nazarene
resources.mission: The Church of the Nazarene's mission is to make Christlike disciples in the nations. This mission is rooted in the Great Commandment and the Great Commission. The church emphasizes being Christian, holiness, and missional, with a focus on equipping believers to live out their faith in the world.
resources.fees: None. Members pay tithes. Fees charges are to support the cost of events.

resources.name: Unisphere Film Festival Inc.
resources.mission: Unisphere Queens Film Festival was founded in 2024 with a single purpose in mind: to put Queens on the map as a vital hub for filmmaking and the arts. We aim to expand recognition of what we feel is the greatest borough in New York City. We run the local filmmaker's platform of opportunities and expand the local film network by showcasing films that carry riveting and thoughtprovoking stories.

resources.name: Volunteers for Springfield Park, Inc.
resources.mission: Volunteers for Springfield Park is a group of dedicated volunteers restoring our park for over 10 years. We reach out to our community to perform workshops, events, activities for seniors, youths & the community. We collaborate with churches, businesses, etc for the upkeep of the community. We are looking for volunteers who are able to teach basic computer skills for seniors and those who need social media skills applications, and volunteers who will be able to assist in the beautification of the park during the spring and summer seasons.

resources.name: Word of Faith
resources.mission: Word of Faith Deliverance Ministry is a caring church seeking to further the Kingdom of God by empowering individuals and families to advance, excel and mature in the things of God. We endeavor to do this through sound teaching, outreach, impartation, and spiritual enrichment.
